(1) there is no black-box construction of correlation-secure trapdoor functions from one-way trapdoor functions; and (2) there is no correlation-secure injective trapdoor function from one-way trap-door permutations.
(a) correlation security is a stronger notion than one-wayness, and (b) there is no black-box separation between the two notions.
